A second brain is a single store of notes, documents and code that an AI
assistant can search and answer questions from, so that work already done is
found again instead of redone. The first two sources to feed into it are the
Google Drive folder and this repository. Nothing is built yet, and the purpose
still has to be scoped. This folder holds the reminder and the open questions.

## Documents

- [Working specification](specification.qmd). What a second brain is, the
  sources to feed into it, the candidate tools, and the questions that decide
  the scope.

- [Google Doc integration brainstorming](<2026-09-30- Brainstorming - Google Doc Integration.qmd>).
  A proposed workflow for reviewing Google Drive documents, approving ingestion,
  and retaining useful knowledge in TrinityMetrics.
